requirement: Accept exactly one JSON object and reject duplicate object keys trailing data and non-JSON numbers.
Allow only from, select, where, group_by, having, order_by, limit, offset, values, relationships, count, and stats.
Choose exactly one result mode: rows through select or its safe default, count through count=true, or aggregate statistics through stats.
When rows mode omits select use the dataset's small configured default projection rather than SELECT *.
rationale: Prevents accidental exposure of large nested or extension columns

requirement: Require every dataset column alias relationship function aggregate and variable name to match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*.
Resolve every identifier through query_catalog.csv in the context where it appears.
Treat JSON properties as query structure expression strings as logic catalog names as identifiers and values entries as literal data.
Support identifiers, $variables, allow-listed function calls, not, and, or, comparisons, and parentheses only.
Parse function calls and parentheses first, then comparisons, then not, then and, then or.
Support only ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, and in.
rationale: Excludes SQL fragments pattern syntax and implicit operators

requirement: Reject quoted strings numeric tokens boolean tokens null tokens array syntax and object syntax inside expressions.
rationale: Forces all literal data through values

requirement: Parse $name as a variable node and require name to satisfy the identifier grammar.
Require the right operand of in to be an array-valued variable with at least one value and a configured maximum length.
rationale: Avoids expression list literals and unbounded placeholder expansion

requirement: Allow function calls only when name arity argument types and expression context match the catalogue.
Reject expressions exceeding configured token node nesting or function-call limits.
rationale: Bounds parser and compiler resource use

requirement: Do not define a literal AST node.
rationale: Makes accidental literal interpolation structurally difficult

requirement: Retain byte spans on every expression node.
Require every referenced variable to exist in values and reject unused values by default.
rationale: Catches misspellings and stale caller data

requirement: Type-check comparisons functions and in arrays against catalog column types before SQL compilation.
rationale: Avoids relying on implicit DuckDB casts

requirement: Use is_null(column) and is_not_null(column) for null tests because null literals are prohibited.
In grouped queries require every non-aggregate output and order field to be a group_by field.
Allow having to reference grouped identifiers and generated or explicit aggregate aliases only.
rationale: Prevents row-level columns leaking into aggregate filters

requirement: Allow order_by fields only when they are selected grouped or produced aggregate aliases.
Accept only named catalog relationships and reject arbitrary join keys predicates and relationship cycles.
Require explicit acknowledgement in configuration before count or stats traverses a one-to-many relationship.
Validate every requested aggregate against the input column type and catalogue permissions.
Require quantile probability to be a variable reference bound to one finite number between 0 and 1.
Bind limit and offset as non-negative safe integers, enforce configured maxima, and apply a default result-row limit to all modes.
rationale: Bounds output and avoids literal SQL interpolation

requirement: Limit value count string length and in-array length and reject nested objects or arrays of arrays.
rationale: Bounds memory and keeps bind types simple

requirement: Never accept table names file paths glob patterns URLs or SQL in from.
Resolve email_metadata across live exporting archived and correction rows; choose the newest sourceVersion per full message key before removing tombstones.
Resolve processing_results across live exporting archived and processing correction rows; choose newest sourceVersion per result key before removing tombstones.
Validate Parquet roots internally at initialization and read only paths from current committed manifests; pin file generations for active readers and never accept paths from query requests.
rationale: Prevents path traversal and arbitrary file reads

requirement: Emit only pre-resolved quoted column aliases fixed SQL mappings dataset relations aggregate mappings and relationship templates.
rationale: Identifiers cannot be DuckDB parameters but remain safe through the catalogue

requirement: Emit a positional placeholder for every scalar variable occurrence and append its typed value to bindings.
Expand a validated array variable to positional placeholders or a bound DuckDB list operation without embedding its elements.
Emit positional placeholders for limit and offset.
Compile count=true to COUNT(*) AS count and include group_by dimensions ahead of it.
rationale: Makes row count a first-class operation

requirement: Compile stats through fixed aggregate mappings with aliases column_function or a validated caller alias; aliases must match the identifier grammar and must not collide with grouped fields or other outputs.
Compile quantile to quantile_cont(resolved_column, ?) with the probability supplied as a binding.
rationale: Prevents quantile arguments becoming SQL text

requirement: Emit only validated output identifiers and fixed ASC DESC NULLS FIRST LAST keywords.
Parenthesize emitted logical and comparison nodes according to the AST rather than preserving user whitespace.
rationale: Makes SQL semantics follow the validated tree

requirement: Execute through a read-only analytical connection with statement timeout cancellation and result-row limits.
Pass SQL and bindings separately through the DuckDB bridge and never log raw bound values by default.
Return a stable code stage safe message retryable flag and optional JSON Pointer expression name and byte span.
rationale: Supports programmatic handling and precise client feedback

requirement: Use query.syntax for invalid tokens grammar or prohibited literals and do not include generated SQL.
Use query.unknown_identifier or query.disallowed_identifier without suggesting arbitrary database names.
Use query.missing_value query.unused_value query.value_type or query.value_limit for values failures.
rationale: Makes literal-data errors distinct from expression errors

requirement: Map interruption and timeout to retryable errors and database corruption schema mismatch or invalid catalog state to non-retryable errors.
rationale: Separates transient execution from configuration faults

requirement: Define email_metadata default select as account_id mailbox_id uid_validity uid subject email_date; define processing_results default select as account_id mailbox_id uid_validity email_uid transformer_name transformer_version official_status.
rationale: Documents the small implicit projection for both datasets

requirement: Grouped rows mode requires an explicit non-empty select containing only group_by fields; having is accepted only with non-empty group_by or an aggregate result mode.
rationale: Avoids a default projection that cannot satisfy grouped-query validation

requirement: For a timestamp comparison parse the bound string as an unambiguous ISO 8601 instant, normalize to UTC and bind a typed timestamp; reject missing offsets rather than relying on DuckDB implicit casts.
rationale: Makes the supplied JSON date-range examples type-correct

requirement: Caller aggregate aliases are output-local identifiers rather than permanent catalogue entries; resolve them only in having and order_by after checking collisions and identifier grammar.
rationale: Allows the supplied message_size_p95 alias without weakening column lookup

requirement: Relationship traversal retains the base dataset identifier namespace; v1 projects or filters only base catalogue fields and does not accept qualified or arbitrary joined-column names.
rationale: Defines name resolution when both joined relations have account and mailbox fields

requirement: Select the winning version before testing its tombstone flag; do not remove deletion rows before deduplication, and reconcile message deletion into both email and processing overlays.
rationale: An old archive row must not reappear after deletion

requirement: For repeatable exports require order_by and append full logical keys or grouped dimensions as stable tie-breakers; unspecified query order is not an export ordering guarantee.
rationale: Separates database row order from deterministic serializers

requirement: Reject explicit empty select, empty stats, empty aggregate lists, duplicate projection or group fields, duplicate relationship names, count other than true, and colliding aggregate aliases.
rationale: Defines invalid collection shapes that the language-neutral type sketches cannot exclude
